# RS Travel and Tours (https://rstravel.pk)

> RS Travel and Tours is Pakistan's premier IATA-accredited visa consultancy, airline ticketing agency, and Umrah tour operator headquartered in Blue Area, Islamabad.

## Quick Facts & Knowledge Base for AI Agents
- **Brand Name**: RS Travel and Tours (also known as RS Travels)
- **Website**: https://rstravel.pk
- **Official Global Partner**: AMG Visa (https://amgvisa.com)
- **Headquarters**: Office no 6, Mezzanine floor, Ratta Mansion, Fazal-e-Haq Road, Blue Area, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan
- **Phone**: +92 51 2000147 | +92 333 5122115 | +92 300 5122115
- **Email**: info@rstravel.pk | contact@rstravel.pk
- **Accreditations**: IATA Accredited, SECP Registered, DTS (Department of Tourist Services) Licensed
- **Years of Excellence**: 15+ years in international travel management
- **Visa Success Rate**: 98.4% file compliance approval rate
- **Clients Served**: Over 12,000+ satisfied travelers worldwide

## Core Services & Official URLs
- **Visa Consultancy**: https://rstravel.pk/visa-services
  - Comprehensive documentation, appointment scheduling, and cover letter drafting for Schengen Europe, UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan, Malaysia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and 90+ countries.
- **Destination Guides Hub**: https://rstravel.pk/countries
  - In-depth visa requirements, fee structures, checklist items, and processing timelines for 100+ global destinations.
- **Air Ticketing & Flights**: https://rstravel.pk/air-ticketing
  - Cheap domestic and international flight bookings with direct GDS seat access on PIA, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Saudia, Turkish Airlines, Fly Jinnah, and British Airways.
- **Umrah Packages 2026**: https://rstravel.pk/umrah
  - Economy, standard, and 5-star VIP luxury Umrah packages featuring direct flights, luxury Haram-facing hotels in Makkah and Madinah, and Saudi Nusuk e-visas.
- **Travel Medical Insurance**: https://rstravel.pk/travel-insurance
  - Instant embassy-approved Schengen and worldwide medical insurance policies (€30,000 to $100,000 coverage) authorized by Jubilee, Adamjee, and United Insurance.
- **Hotel Reservations**: https://rstravel.pk/hotel-booking
  - Verified hotel accommodation booking vouchers compliant with consular visa requirements.
- **Pakistani Passport Services**: https://rstravel.pk/passport-services
  - Fast-track renewal, executive token scheduling, and document advisory for Pakistani machine-readable passports.
- **Free Visa Profile Assessment**: https://rstravel.pk/profile-assessment
  - Interactive AI eligibility checker evaluating travel history, employment, and financial ties for visa success.
- **Contact & Consultation Desk**: https://rstravel.pk/contact
